The heading and the start of the item about the proposed match are missing.

ocr.notes: First two lines garbled; the rest mostly right.

title.suggested: Tom Allen Named Among St. Louis Boxing Teachers

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican praised a benefit for Charles Daly and Father Tom Kelly's work for boxing, saying that with Tom Allen and Kelly to teach the youngsters, St. Louis should become the premier resort of boxing champions.

metadata.notes: Masthead: 'The Republican: St. Louis, Monday Morning, February 28, 1887', page 5. Before 1888 the paper is the Missouri Republican, not the St. Louis Republic.

notes: Allen is named only once, as one of the veterans who could teach young boxers in St. Louis. No citable facts.
